invention.ref: Nathaniel Baldwin builds a prototype telephone headset
invention.ref_zh: 鲍德温制作电话头戴式耳机原型

mass_production.ref: Baldwin and partners set up manufacturing in Utah
mass_production.ref_zh: 鲍德温与合作方在犹他州建厂生产

popularization.ref_zh: 鲍德温云母振膜收音机耳机流行

locations.place_label_zh: 美国犹他州（以盐湖城示意）

notes: 法国工程师 Mercadier 1891 年就为入耳式耳机申请过专利。之后的演进：1958 年密尔沃基的约翰·科斯推出第一副立体声耳机，1979 年随身听让轻便耳机普及，后来的入耳式耳塞、无线耳机都属于耳机的进化。
summary_zh: 1910 年，犹他州的纳撒尼尔·鲍德温为了在礼拜时听清布道，做出头戴式耳机原型；后来的立体声耳机、入耳式耳塞都是它的演进。
summary_en: In 1910 Utah's Nathaniel Baldwin, unable to hear Sunday sermons, built a prototype headset; stereo headphones and in-ear earbuds evolved from it later.

image.alt_zh: 耳机架上的 AKG 头戴式耳机
image.alt_en: AKG over-ear headphones on a stand

notes_en: French engineer Ernest Mercadier patented in-ear headphones as early as 1891. Later evolution: John Koss of Milwaukee made the first stereo headphones in 1958, the 1979 Walkman popularized lightweight headphones, and in-ear and wireless earbuds followed.
